description: A team plans projects as tasks, where some tasks must wait for others.
data: projects with a name (unique) and whether the project is archived
tasks of a project with a title, a status (to do, doing or done) and optionally the task that must be finished first
actions: team members add tasks to a project
team members start and finish tasks
team members see a project's progress
the team lead archives a finished project
rules: a task cannot be started until the task it waits for is done
a task goes from to do to doing to done
a task that another task waits for cannot be deleted
a task can only wait for a task in the same project
a project can be archived only when it has tasks and all of them are done
no tasks can be added to an archived project
